brief:
The Israeli military said its Paratroopers Brigade killed two Palestinians in Gaza after they crossed the so-called "yellow line," according to Middle East Eye. The designation refers to a boundary established under a US-brokered agreement between Israel and armed groups operating in the territory.

The military statement did not specify the identities of the two Palestinians or provide additional context about the circumstances surrounding the killing. No armed group immediately claimed responsibility for the individuals or commented on the incident. The "yellow line" has served as a demarcation point under the ceasefire arrangement negotiated with American mediation.
